arrive.title: YOU ARRIVE
lines: The lights are on, which you had stopped expecting.
Somebody opens the gate before you reach it.

hp.title: YOU DON'T GET UP
lines: It wasn't one thing. It never is.

fuel.title: STRANDED
lines: The engine turns over twice and stops pretending.
You walk for a while. Not far enough.

water.title: THIRST
lines: Three days is the number people quote. It is optimistic.

food.title: HUNGER
lines: You stop feeling it near the end, which is the worst part.

caught.title: CAUGHT
lines: A torch, then three more, and no way back to the fence.
You went in without anything to argue with.
The post sells protection. That is what it is for.
